source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: It is known to all (a) gold is a valuable metal.
explanation_en: Here we need a conjunction to introduce a noun clause as the object of 'known to all'. 'That' is used to introduce a fact or statement. 'Which' is a relative pronoun for things, 'what' means 'the thing that', 'why' asks reason – incorrect.
explanation_bn: এখানে 'known to all'-এর object হিসেবে noun clause শুরু করতে conjunction প্রয়োজন। 'That' একটি সত্য বা বিবৃতি প্রকাশ করতে ব্যবহৃত হয়। 'Which' বস্তুর জন্য relative pronoun, 'what' মানে 'যেটি', 'why' কারণ জিজ্ঞেস করে – ভুল।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (b) they glitter for sometimes, they fade away in the long run.
explanation_en: The sentence shows contrast: they glitter but eventually fade. 'Though/Although' expresses concession. 'Because' shows cause, 'If' condition, 'When' time – incorrect.
explanation_bn: বাক্যটি বৈপরীত্য প্রকাশ করে: তারা কিছুক্ষণ জ্বলজ্বল করে কিন্তু শেষে ম্লান হয়ে যায়। 'Though/Although' স্বীকৃতি বোঝায়। 'Because' কারণ, 'If' শর্ত, 'When' সময় – ভুল।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: In our society there are also many people (c) are outwardly very gentle and polished.
explanation_en: Relative pronoun for people as subject of the clause. 'Who' is correct. 'Which' is for things, 'whom' for object, 'whose' for possession.
explanation_bn: মানুষের জন্য subject হিসেবে relative pronoun। 'Who' সঠিক। 'Which' বস্তুর জন্য, 'whom' object-এর জন্য, 'whose' মালিকানার জন্য।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Later on, their real identity is revealed (d) they do not exercise moral value.
explanation_en: 'As' here means 'because' – gives the reason why identity is revealed. 'Because' is also possible but answer sheet gives 'as'. 'So' shows result, 'that' introduces noun clause.
explanation_bn: 'As' এখানে 'কারণ' অর্থে ব্যবহৃত – কেন পরিচয় প্রকাশ পায় তার কারণ দেয়। 'Because' সম্ভব কিন্তু উত্তরপত্রে 'as' দেওয়া আছে। 'So' ফলাফল, 'that' noun clause শুরু করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: That's why people say, 'All (e) glitters is not gold.'
explanation_en: Relative pronoun referring to 'all' (indefinite pronoun). 'All that glitters' is a fixed phrase. 'That' is used after indefinite pronouns like all, everything, nothing.
explanation_bn: 'all' (অনির্দিষ্ট সর্বনাম)-এর জন্য relative pronoun। 'All that glitters' একটি স্থির phrase। 'That' অনির্দিষ্ট সর্বনাম যেমন all, everything, nothing-এর পরে ব্যবহৃত হয়।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Facebook is a social medium (a) is very popular.
explanation_en: Relative pronoun for a thing (social medium) as subject – 'which'.
explanation_bn: বস্তুর (সামাজিক মাধ্যম) জন্য subject হিসেবে relative pronoun – 'which'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (b) it provides the users with various information, all do not use it for positive purposes.
explanation_en: Contrast: Facebook provides information, but not all use it positively. 'Although' shows concession.
explanation_bn: বৈপরীত্য: ফেসবুক তথ্য দেয়, কিন্তু সবাই ইতিবাচকভাবে ব্যবহার করে না। 'Although' স্বীকৃতি বোঝায়।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Many Facebook users (c) some of the youngsters sometimes use it whimsically ...
explanation_en: The connector introduces examples. 'Like' or 'including' is used to specify examples. Answer sheet gives 'like/including'.
explanation_bn: Connector উদাহরণ তুলে ধরে। 'Like' বা 'including' উদাহরণ নির্দেশ করতে ব্যবহৃত হয়। উত্তরপত্রে 'like/including'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: ... which creates (d) misunderstanding (e) destroys social peace and order.
explanation_en: Paired conjunction 'not only ... but also'. 'Not only' is used before the first item.
explanation_bn: যুগ্ম conjunction 'not only ... but also'। প্রথমটির আগে 'not only' বসে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: ... not only misunderstanding (e) destroys social peace and order.
explanation_en: Second part of the paired conjunction 'not only ... but also'. 'But also' completes the pair.
explanation_bn: 'not only ... but also' যুগ্ম conjunction-এর দ্বিতীয় অংশ। 'But also' জোড়াটি সম্পূর্ণ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: We know that trees are very important (a) they produce oxygen ...
explanation_en: Reason why trees are important: they produce oxygen. 'Because' introduces the cause.
explanation_bn: গাছ গুরুত্বপূর্ণ হওয়ার কারণ: তারা অক্সিজেন উৎপন্ন করে। 'Because' কারণ নির্দেশ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: ... they produce oxygen (b) is a must for all living creatures.
explanation_en: Relative pronoun referring to 'oxygen' (thing) as subject – 'which' or 'that'. Answer sheet gives 'which'.
explanation_bn: 'oxygen' (বস্তু) এর জন্য subject হিসেবে relative pronoun – 'which' বা 'that'। উত্তরপত্রে 'which'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: They are our best friends (c) we are not conscious of it.
explanation_en: Contrast: trees are best friends, but we are not conscious. 'But' shows opposition.
explanation_bn: বৈপরীত্য: গাছ আমাদের বন্ধু, কিন্তু আমরা সচেতন নই। 'But' বিরোধিতা বোঝায়।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Time is coming (d) there will be no tree left for us.
explanation_en: Relative adverb for time – 'when' modifies 'time'.
explanation_bn: সময়ের জন্য relative adverb – 'when' 'time' কে modify করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (e) we should plant more and more trees for our own sake.
explanation_en: Conclusion or result of the previous statement. 'So' or 'Therefore' indicates consequence.
explanation_bn: পূর্ববর্তী বিবৃতির উপসংহার বা ফলাফল। 'So' বা 'Therefore' ফলাফল নির্দেশ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: It is known to all (a) about half of our population are women.
explanation_en: Same as 1a – noun clause after 'known to all'.
explanation_bn: 1a এর মতো – 'known to all' এর পরে noun clause।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: They are entitled to equal rights and privileges (b) men enjoy,
explanation_en: 'As' is used to show comparison or similarity – rights and privileges as men enjoy.
explanation_bn: 'As' তুলনা বা সাদৃশ্য বোঝাতে ব্যবহৃত হয় – পুরুষের মতো অধিকার ও সুযোগ।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (c) in reality, they do not get their dues.
explanation_en: Contrast between entitlement and reality. 'But' shows opposition.
explanation_bn: অধিকার এবং বাস্তবতার মধ্যে বৈপরীত্য। 'But' বিরোধিতা বোঝায়।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (d) every woman is a potential mother and her influence on her children is very great.
explanation_en: Reason why women should be given proper education: because every woman is a potential mother.
explanation_bn: মহিলাদের সঠিক শিক্ষা দেওয়ার কারণ: কারণ প্রতিটি মহিলা সম্ভাব্য মা।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (e) we should pay proper attention to our women folk.
explanation_en: Conclusion from the previous argument. 'So' introduces the result.
explanation_bn: পূর্ববর্তী যুক্তির উপসংহার। 'So' ফলাফল নির্দেশ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (a) it is a simple exercise, it is good for health both physically (b) mentally.
explanation_en: Contrast: simple exercise yet good for health. 'Though' shows concession.
explanation_bn: বৈপরীত্য: সরল ব্যায়াম কিন্তু স্বাস্থ্যের জন্য ভালো। 'Though' স্বীকৃতি বোঝায়।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: ... good for health both physically (b) mentally.
explanation_en: 'Both ... and' is a paired conjunction. 'And' connects the two adjectives.
explanation_bn: 'Both ... and' একটি যুগ্ম conjunction। 'And' দুটি adjective যুক্ত করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (c) the morning air is fresh and free from any kind of noise and pollutions, it keeps us sound and healthy.
explanation_en: Reason: because the morning air is fresh, it keeps us healthy. 'As' or 'Since' gives cause.
explanation_bn: কারণ: সকালের বাতাস সতেজ বলেই এটি আমাদের সুস্থ রাখে। 'As' বা 'Since' কারণ নির্দেশ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Morning walk costs nothing (d) gives more.
explanation_en: Contrast: costs nothing yet gives more. 'But' shows opposition.
explanation_bn: বৈপরীত্য: কিছু খরচ করে না কিন্তু বেশি দেয়। 'But' বিরোধিতা বোঝায়।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (e) we should make the habit of morning walk.
explanation_en: Conclusion from the benefits mentioned. 'So' or 'Thus' introduces the result.
explanation_bn: উল্লেখিত সুবিধার উপসংহার। 'So' বা 'Thus' ফলাফল নির্দেশ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Almost all countries of the world suffer from the curse of unemployment problem. (a) nowhere in the world this problem is so acute as in our country.
explanation_en: Contrast: all countries suffer, but nowhere as acute as in our country. 'But' introduces contrast.
explanation_bn: বৈপরীত্য: সব দেশ ভোগে, কিন্তু আমাদের দেশের মতো তীব্র কোথাও নয়। 'But' বৈপরীত্য নির্দেশ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: There are many reasons behind it. (b) our country is industrially backward.
explanation_en: Listing the first reason. 'Firstly' or 'First of all' introduces the first point.
explanation_bn: প্রথম কারণ তালিকাভুক্ত করা। 'Firstly' বা 'First of all' প্রথম বিষয়টি উল্লেখ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (c) our system of education fails to give a student an independent start of life.
explanation_en: Second reason in the list. 'Secondly' is correct.
explanation_bn: তালিকার দ্বিতীয় কারণ। 'Secondly' সঠিক।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: It has little provision for vocational training. (d) our students and youths have a false sense of dignity.
explanation_en: 'Again' here means 'another point' or 'furthermore'. It adds another reason.
explanation_bn: 'Again' এখানে 'আরেকটি বিষয়' বা 'অধিকন্তু' অর্থে ব্যবহৃত। এটি আরেকটি কারণ যোগ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (e) they run after jobs only.
explanation_en: Conclusion from the previous reasons. 'Thus' or 'Therefore' introduces the result.
explanation_bn: পূর্ববর্তী কারণগুলোর উপসংহার। 'Thus' বা 'Therefore' ফলাফল নির্দেশ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Trees are very important (a) They produce oxygen ...
explanation_en: 'Indeed' is used to emphasize a statement – trees are indeed important. It is a sentence connector. Answer sheet gives 'indeed'.
explanation_bn: 'Indeed' একটি বিবৃতিকে জোর দিতে ব্যবহৃত হয় – গাছ সত্যিই গুরুত্বপূর্ণ। উত্তরপত্রে 'indeed'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: They produce oxygen (b) is a must for man and all living beings.
explanation_en: Relative pronoun for 'oxygen' – 'that' or 'which'.
explanation_bn: 'oxygen' এর জন্য relative pronoun – 'that' বা 'which'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: We must realize (c) they help us in many ways.
explanation_en: Noun clause as object of 'realize' – 'that' introduces the clause.
explanation_bn: 'realize' এর object হিসেবে noun clause – 'that' clause শুরু করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (d) trees are less in number, there will be an increased amount of carbon di-oxide in the atmosphere ...
explanation_en: Conditional clause: if trees are fewer, then CO2 increases. 'If' introduces condition.
explanation_bn: শর্তসাপেক্ষ clause: যদি গাছ কম হয়, তাহলে CO2 বাড়ে। 'If' শর্ত নির্দেশ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: ... there will be an increased amount of carbon di-oxide in the atmosphere (e) it will enhance greenhouse effect.
explanation_en: Addition: more CO2 and this enhances greenhouse effect. 'And' connects two related statements.
explanation_bn: সংযোজন: বেশি CO2 এবং এটি গ্রিনহাউস প্রভাব বাড়ায়। 'And' দুটি সম্পর্কিত বিবৃতি যুক্ত করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: We can't deny the importance of tree plantation, (a) our lives on earth directly or indirectly depend on it.
explanation_en: Reason why we can't deny: because our lives depend on it. 'As/because/since' give cause.
explanation_bn: আমরা অস্বীকার করতে পারি না কেন: কারণ আমাদের জীবন এর ওপর নির্ভরশীল। 'As/because/since' কারণ নির্দেশ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (b) it is a matter of sorrow that we are cutting down trees indiscriminately.
explanation_en: Contrast: importance of trees vs. cutting them down. 'But' shows contrast.
explanation_bn: বৈপরীত্য: গাছের গুরুত্ব বনাম সেগুলো কাটা। 'But' বৈপরীত্য বোঝায়।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (c) trees are planted more and more, soon our country will turn into a desert.
explanation_en: Conditional: if we do NOT plant more trees, desert will come. 'Unless' means 'if not'.
explanation_bn: শর্তসাপেক্ষ: যদি আমরা বেশি গাছ না লাগাই, তাহলে মরুভূমি আসবে। 'Unless' মানে 'যদি না'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (d) there will be a harmful change in the climate.
explanation_en: Adding another consequence: besides desert, climate change. 'Besides' or 'Moreover' adds information.
explanation_bn: আরেকটি পরিণতি যোগ করা: মরুভূমি ছাড়াও জলবায়ু পরিবর্তন। 'Besides' বা 'Moreover' তথ্য যোগ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (e) we should plant more and more trees for our own sake.
explanation_en: Conclusion from the arguments. 'So/Therefore' indicate result.
explanation_bn: যুক্তির উপসংহার। 'So/Therefore' ফলাফল নির্দেশ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: The rapid growth of population must be controlled. (a) all sorts of attempts to solve food problem will fail.
explanation_en: 'Otherwise' means 'if not' – if population is not controlled, then food attempts fail. It shows the negative consequence.
explanation_bn: 'Otherwise' মানে 'যদি না' – যদি জনসংখ্যা নিয়ন্ত্রণ না করা হয়, তাহলে খাদ্য প্রচেষ্টা ব্যর্থ হবে। এটি নেতিবাচক পরিণতি দেখায়।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (b) we have to increase our food production very rapidly.
explanation_en: 'At the same time' introduces an additional point that must happen concurrently.
explanation_bn: 'At the same time' একটি অতিরিক্ত বিষয় উল্লেখ করে যা একই সাথে করতে হবে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: We may mostly, solve our food problem by changing our habit. (c) we can take potato instead of rice.
explanation_en: Giving an example of changing habit. 'For instance' introduces an example.
explanation_bn: অভ্যাস পরিবর্তনের উদাহরণ দেওয়া। 'For instance' একটি উদাহরণ দেয়।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (d) it is high time we changed our eating habit.
explanation_en: Conclusion from the previous suggestion. 'So' introduces the result/advice.
explanation_bn: পূর্ববর্তী পরামর্শের উপসংহার। 'So' ফলাফল/পরামর্শ নির্দেশ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (e) knowledge of nutritive value of food can help to solve our food problem to a great extent.
explanation_en: Introducing the final point in a list. 'Last of all' is appropriate.
explanation_bn: তালিকার চূড়ান্ত বিষয় উল্লেখ করা। 'Last of all' সঠিক।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: The greatness of a book depends (a) on the accountability among the readers.
explanation_en: Adverb modifying 'depends' – to a large extent. 'Largely' or 'mainly' means 'mostly'.
explanation_bn: Adverb 'depends' কে modify করে – অনেকাংশে। 'Largely' বা 'mainly' মানে 'প্রধানত'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: If we read a book only once, we cannot discover many things in it. (b) basing on one reading, we cannot judge the standard of a book.
explanation_en: Adding another reason. 'Moreover' or 'Besides' adds information.
explanation_bn: আরেকটি কারণ যোগ করা। 'Moreover' বা 'Besides' তথ্য যোগ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (c) a book is praised highly, we have no doubt about the greatness of the book.
explanation_en: Condition: if a book is praised, then we have no doubt. 'If' introduces the condition.
explanation_bn: শর্ত: যদি একটি বই অত্যন্ত প্রশংসিত হয়, তাহলে আমাদের কোনো সন্দেহ নেই। 'If' শর্ত নির্দেশ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (d) by the first reading, we may not understand a book.
explanation_en: Contrast with the previous idea (if praised, no doubt – but even then, first reading may not reveal greatness). 'However' shows contrast.
explanation_bn: পূর্ববর্তী ধারণার সাথে বৈপরীত্য (যদি প্রশংসিত, সন্দেহ নেই – কিন্তু তবুও, প্রথম পড়ায় বোঝা নাও যেতে পারে)। 'However' বৈপরীত্য দেখায়।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (e) if it is read more than once, we can understand the greatness of the book easily.
explanation_en: Contrast: however we may not understand on first reading, but if read more than once, we can. 'But' introduces the contrasting idea.
explanation_bn: বৈপরীত্য: প্রথম পড়ায় না বোঝা গেলেও, একাধিকবার পড়লে বোঝা যায়। 'But' বৈপরীত্য নির্দেশ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Teaching is such a profession (a) helps to build a nation.
explanation_en: 'Such ... that' is a fixed correlative conjunction. 'That' introduces the result clause.
explanation_bn: 'Such ... that' একটি নির্দিষ্ট যুগ্ম conjunction। 'That' ফলাফল clause শুরু করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: A teacher is (b) a guide (c) a pioneer.
explanation_en: Paired conjunction: both ... and / not only ... but also. 'Both' or 'not only' starts the pair.
explanation_bn: যুগ্ম conjunction: both ... and / not only ... but also। 'Both' বা 'not only' জোড়া শুরু করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: A teacher is both a guide (c) a pioneer.
explanation_en: Second part of the paired conjunction: 'both ... and' or 'not only ... but also'. Answer sheet gives 'and/but also'.
explanation_bn: যুগ্ম conjunction-এর দ্বিতীয় অংশ: 'both ... and' বা 'not only ... but also'। উত্তরপত্রে 'and/but also'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: He has to dedicate to this noble profession in order to guide the nation. (d) he is called an architect of a new society.
explanation_en: Result/conclusion from the previous statement. 'That is why' or 'So' indicates consequence.
explanation_bn: পূর্ববর্তী বিবৃতির ফলাফল/উপসংহার। 'That is why' বা 'So' পরিণতি নির্দেশ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (e) he neglects his duties, social discipline will break down.
explanation_en: Condition: if he neglects duties, then discipline breaks down. 'If' introduces condition.
explanation_bn: শর্ত: যদি তিনি কর্তব্য অবহেলা করেন, তাহলে শৃঙ্খলা ভাঙে। 'If' শর্ত নির্দেশ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: None can deny the importance of tree plantation (a) our lives on earth inevitably depend on it.
explanation_en: Reason: because our lives depend on it. Same as 8a.
explanation_bn: কারণ: আমাদের জীবন এর উপর নির্ভরশীল। 8a এর মতো।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (b) it is a matter of sorrow that we are cutting down trees indiscriminately.
explanation_en: Contrast: importance vs. cutting. Same as 8b.
explanation_bn: বৈপরীত্য: গুরুত্ব বনাম কাটা। 8b এর মতো।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (c) trees are planted, soon our country will turn into desert.
explanation_en: Conditional: if not planted, desert. Same as 8c.
explanation_bn: শর্তসাপেক্ষ: না লাগালে মরুভূমি। 8c এর মতো।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (d) there will be an adverse change in the climate.
explanation_en: Result of deforestation. 'Consequently' or 'Then' shows the outcome.
explanation_bn: বন উজাড়ের ফলাফল। 'Consequently' বা 'Then' পরিণতি দেখায়।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (e) we should plant more and more trees for our own sake.
explanation_en: Conclusion. Same as 8e.
explanation_bn: উপসংহার। 8e এর মতো।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Bangladesh is a small country (a) it has a large population.
explanation_en: Contrast: small country but large population. 'But' shows opposition.
explanation_bn: বৈপরীত্য: ছোট দেশ কিন্তু বড় জনসংখ্যা। 'But' বিরোধিতা বোঝায়।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: A great number of people are poor (b) illiterate.
explanation_en: Addition: poor and illiterate – both conditions exist. 'And' adds.
explanation_bn: সংযোজন: দরিদ্র এবং নিরক্ষর – উভয় অবস্থা বিদ্যমান। 'And' যোগ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (c) we want to develop the country, we must control the rapid growth of population.
explanation_en: Condition: if we want development, then control population. 'If' introduces condition.
explanation_bn: শর্ত: যদি উন্নয়ন চাই, তাহলে জনসংখ্যা নিয়ন্ত্রণ করতে হবে। 'If' শর্ত নির্দেশ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (d) we have to face a great problem.
explanation_en: 'Otherwise' means 'if not' – if we don't control population, we face problems.
explanation_bn: 'Otherwise' মানে 'যদি না' – যদি জনসংখ্যা নিয়ন্ত্রণ না করি, তাহলে সমস্যার মুখোমুখি হব।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: But it is a matter of joy (e) our government is trying to solve the problem.
explanation_en: Noun clause after 'a matter of joy' – 'that' introduces the clause.
explanation_bn: 'a matter of joy' এর পরে noun clause – 'that' clause শুরু করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Summer noon is very painful and disgusting. (a) the sun shines hotly over head, life becomes miserable.
explanation_en: Time: when the sun shines, life becomes miserable. 'When' indicates time.
explanation_bn: সময়: যখন সূর্য জ্বলে, জীবন দুর্বিষহ হয়। 'When' সময় নির্দেশ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: The sufferings of the people know no bounds (b) the electricity goes off.
explanation_en: Condition: if electricity goes off, sufferings increase. 'If' introduces condition.
explanation_bn: শর্ত: যদি বিদ্যুৎ চলে যায়, কষ্ট বাড়ে। 'If' শর্ত নির্দেশ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (c) the people use hand fans to fan themselves.
explanation_en: In that situation, people use hand fans. 'Then' shows the consequent action.
explanation_bn: সেই পরিস্থিতিতে, মানুষ হাতে পাখা ব্যবহার করে। 'Then' পরবর্তী কাজ দেখায়।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Children can neither sleep (d) read.
explanation_en: Paired conjunction 'neither ... nor' – used for two negative statements.
explanation_bn: যুগ্ম conjunction 'neither ... nor' – দুটি নেতিবাচক বিবৃতির জন্য।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (e) the poor suffer most.
explanation_en: Contrast: children and others suffer, but the poor suffer most. 'But' shows contrast.
explanation_bn: বৈপরীত্য: শিশু ও অন্যেরা কষ্ট পায়, কিন্তু দরিদ্ররা সবচেয়ে বেশি কষ্ট পায়। 'But' বৈপরীত্য দেখায়।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Truthfulness is the greatest of all virtues. (a) we do not cultivate the habit of speaking the truth, we cannot command the confidence of others.
explanation_en: Condition: if we don't cultivate truthfulness, then we cannot gain confidence. 'If' introduces condition.
explanation_bn: শর্ত: যদি আমরা সত্যবাদিতার অভ্যাস না গড়ি, তাহলে অন্যের আস্থা অর্জন করতে পারি না। 'If' শর্ত নির্দেশ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: A lie never lies hidden. (b) it will come out today or tomorrow.
explanation_en: Reason: because a lie will eventually be exposed. 'Because' gives cause.
explanation_bn: কারণ: মিথ্যা অবশেষে প্রকাশ পাবে। 'Because' কারণ নির্দেশ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (c) all despise him without considering his social status.
explanation_en: Result: then everyone despises him. 'Then' shows the consequence.
explanation_bn: ফলাফল: তখন সবাই তাকে ঘৃণা করে। 'Then' পরিণতি দেখায়।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: The habit of speaking the truth, (d) must be formed from the very childhood.
explanation_en: Conclusion from the previous arguments. 'Therefore' indicates a logical conclusion.
explanation_bn: পূর্ববর্তী যুক্তিগুলোর উপসংহার। 'Therefore' একটি যৌক্তিক উপসংহার নির্দেশ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: We should know (e) speaking the truth is the most rewarding thing in life.
explanation_en: Noun clause as object of 'know' – 'that' introduces the clause.
explanation_bn: 'know' এর object হিসেবে noun clause – 'that' clause শুরু করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Honesty is the best way of leading life through (a) one can get mental peace.
explanation_en: Relative pronoun referring to 'way' – 'through which' means 'by which'. 'Which' is correct.
explanation_bn: 'way' এর জন্য relative pronoun – 'through which' মানে 'যার দ্বারা'। 'Which' সঠিক।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: It is a great national virtue (b) leads a man to the way of humanity.
explanation_en: Relative pronoun for 'virtue' (thing) as subject – 'that' or 'which'. Answer sheet gives 'that'.
explanation_bn: 'virtue' (গুণ) এর জন্য subject হিসেবে relative pronoun – 'that' বা 'which'। উত্তরপত্রে 'that'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Life of a man is not very peaceful (c) honesty can open a door of peace before him.
explanation_en: Contrast: life is not peaceful, but honesty can bring peace. 'But' shows contrast.
explanation_bn: বৈপরীত্য: জীবন খুব শান্তিপূর্ণ নয়, কিন্তু সততা শান্তি আনতে পারে। 'But' বৈপরীত্য দেখায়।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: An honest man is more respected (d) other men.
explanation_en: Comparative 'more respected than' – 'than' is used after comparative adjectives.
explanation_bn: তুলনামূলক 'more respected than' – তুলনামূলক বিশেষণের পরে 'than' ব্যবহৃত হয়।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (e) we shall never be dishonest in our life.
explanation_en: Conclusion from the discussion. 'So' gives the result/advice.
explanation_bn: আলোচনার উপসংহার। 'So' ফলাফল/পরামর্শ দেয়।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: They constitute nearly half of our total population. (a) there can be no denying the fact (b) they too possess equal rights and duties (c) men do.
explanation_en: 'Actually' or 'In fact' introduces a statement that emphasizes or confirms the previous point.
explanation_bn: 'Actually' বা 'In fact' একটি বিবৃতি প্রবর্তন করে যা পূর্ববর্তী বিষয়কে জোর দেয় বা নিশ্চিত করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: There can be no denying the fact (b) they too possess equal rights and duties (c) men do.
explanation_en: Noun clause after 'the fact' – 'that' introduces the fact.
explanation_bn: 'the fact' এর পরে noun clause – 'that' তথ্যটি উল্লেখ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: ... they too possess equal rights and duties (c) men do.
explanation_en: Comparison: equal rights and duties as men do. 'As' is used for comparison of actions.
explanation_bn: তুলনা: পুরুষদের মতো সমান অধিকার ও কর্তব্য। 'As' কর্মের তুলনার জন্য ব্যবহৃত হয়।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: They have noble mission to fulfil as men. (d) they get opportunity, their genius, powers (e) capacities will bloom fully.
explanation_en: Condition: if they get opportunity, then their abilities bloom. 'If' introduces condition.
explanation_bn: শর্ত: যদি তারা সুযোগ পায়, তাহলে তাদের ক্ষমতা প্রস্ফুটিত হয়। 'If' শর্ত নির্দেশ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: ... their genius, powers (e) capacities will bloom fully.
explanation_en: Listing: genius, powers and capacities. 'And' connects the last item.
explanation_bn: তালিকা: প্রতিভা, ক্ষমতা এবং সামর্থ্য। 'And' শেষ আইটেমটি সংযুক্ত করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: A school magazine is a magazine (a) is published by the school authority annually.
explanation_en: Relative pronoun for 'magazine' (thing) as subject – 'which'.
explanation_bn: 'magazine' (বস্তু) এর জন্য subject হিসেবে relative pronoun – 'which'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: The publication of it is not an easy task (b) it needs time, energy and money.
explanation_en: Reason: because it needs resources. 'As' gives the reason.
explanation_bn: কারণ: কারণ এটির সময়, শক্তি ও অর্থ প্রয়োজন। 'As' কারণ নির্দেশ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (c) a magazine committee is formed from the teachers and the students.
explanation_en: First step in the process. 'First' introduces the initial action.
explanation_bn: প্রক্রিয়ার প্রথম ধাপ। 'First' প্রাথমিক কাজটি উল্লেখ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: The editor (d) is selected or elected by the committee members invites writings.
explanation_en: Relative pronoun for 'editor' (person) as subject – 'who'.
explanation_bn: 'editor' (ব্যক্তি) এর জন্য subject হিসেবে relative pronoun – 'who'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (e) good writings are selected for printing.
explanation_en: Next step after inviting writings. 'Then' or 'Finally' indicates sequence.
explanation_bn: লেখা আমন্ত্রণের পরের ধাপ। 'Then' বা 'Finally' ক্রম নির্দেশ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: The whole world has turned into a global village (a) the improvement of information technology.
explanation_en: Prepositional phrase showing cause. 'Because of' is followed by a noun phrase.
explanation_bn: কারণ দেখানো prepositional phrase। 'Because of' এর পরে noun phrase বসে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Now we can know (b) is happening on the other corner of the world sitting at home.
explanation_en: Noun clause as object of 'know' – 'what' means 'the thing that'.
explanation_bn: 'know' এর object হিসেবে noun clause – 'what' মানে 'যেটি'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: The poor culture is receiving quickly the elements (c) are in rich culture.
explanation_en: Relative pronoun for 'elements' (things) as subject – 'which'.
explanation_bn: 'elements' (বস্তু) এর জন্য subject হিসেবে relative pronoun – 'which'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (d) technology transforms culture and develops it.
explanation_en: Reason: because technology transforms culture. 'Because' introduces cause.
explanation_bn: কারণ: কারণ প্রযুক্তি সংস্কৃতিকে রূপান্তরিত করে। 'Because' কারণ নির্দেশ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (e) we have to prevent the infiltration of bad culture of another society to our own culture.
explanation_en: Contrast: technology transforms culture (good), but we must prevent bad culture. 'But' shows contrast.
explanation_bn: বৈপরীত্য: প্রযুক্তি সংস্কৃতিকে রূপান্তরিত করে (ভালো), কিন্তু আমাদের খারাপ সংস্কৃতি প্রতিরোধ করতে হবে। 'But' বৈপরীত্য দেখায়।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Morning walk is a good habit for all classes of people. (a) it is a simple exercise, it is good for health both physically (b) mentally.
explanation_en: Same as 5a – contrast between simplicity and benefit.
explanation_bn: 5a এর মতো – সরলতা ও উপকারিতার মধ্যে বৈপরীত্য।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: ... good for health both physically (b) mentally.
explanation_en: Same as 5b – 'both ... and'.
explanation_bn: 5b এর মতো – 'both ... and'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (c) the morning air is fresh and free from any kind of noise and pollutions, it keeps us sound and healthy.
explanation_en: Same as 5c – reason.
explanation_bn: 5c এর মতো – কারণ।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Morning walk costs nothing (d) gives more.
explanation_en: Same as 5d – contrast.
explanation_bn: 5d এর মতো – বৈপরীত্য।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (e) we should make the habit of morning walk.
explanation_en: Same as 5e – conclusion.
explanation_bn: 5e এর মতো – উপসংহার।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Many schools have a uniform (a) there are arguments for and against.
explanation_en: Contrast: uniform exists, but arguments exist. 'But' shows opposition.
explanation_bn: বৈপরীত্য: ইউনিফর্ম আছে, কিন্তু যুক্তি বিদ্যমান। 'But' বিরোধিতা বোঝায়।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (b) pupils were allowed to wear clothes according to their own choice.
explanation_en: Refers to a past situation (before the uniform rule). 'Earlier' or 'Previously' indicates time in the past.
explanation_bn: একটি অতীত পরিস্থিতি নির্দেশ করে (ইউনিফর্ম নিয়মের আগে)। 'Earlier' বা 'Previously' অতীত সময় নির্দেশ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (c) some clothes may not be suitable for schools.
explanation_en: Contrast: if pupils chose freely, but some clothes are not suitable. 'But' shows contrast.
explanation_bn: বৈপরীত্য: যদি ছাত্ররা অবাধে পোশাক বেছে নিত, কিন্তু কিছু পোশাক স্কুলের জন্য উপযুক্ত নয়। 'But' বৈপরীত্য দেখায়।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (d) some of the students cannot afford to buy it.
explanation_en: Adding another argument against uniform: besides unsuitability, some can't afford it. 'Besides' adds information.
explanation_bn: ইউনিফর্মের বিরুদ্ধে আরেকটি যুক্তি যোগ করা: অনুপযুক্ততা ছাড়াও, কেউ কেউ কিনতে পারে না। 'Besides' তথ্য যোগ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (e) wearing a school dress is not mandatory in every school.
explanation_en: Conclusion from the arguments: therefore, it's not mandatory everywhere. 'Therefore' shows result.
explanation_bn: যুক্তিগুলোর উপসংহার: অতএব, এটি সর্বত্র বাধ্যতামূলক নয়। 'Therefore' ফলাফল নির্দেশ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: The man (a) possesses this quality is the happiest person in the world.
explanation_en: Relative pronoun for 'man' as subject – 'who'.
explanation_bn: 'man' এর জন্য subject হিসেবে relative pronoun – 'who'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: To be honest, a man should have trustworthiness. (b) nobody trusts a liar.
explanation_en: Reason: because nobody trusts a liar, one must be trustworthy. 'Because' gives the cause.
explanation_bn: কারণ: কারণ কেউ মিথ্যাবাদীকে বিশ্বাস করে না, তাই একজনকে বিশ্বাসযোগ্য হতে হবে। 'Because' কারণ নির্দেশ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (c) Allah helps the honest people.
explanation_en: Adding another reason to be honest. 'Besides' adds information.
explanation_bn: সৎ হওয়ার আরেকটি কারণ যোগ করা। 'Besides' তথ্য যোগ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (d) children should be taught honesty from the very beginning of life.
explanation_en: Conclusion from the previous points – therefore, teach children honesty.
explanation_bn: পূর্ববর্তী বিষয়গুলোর উপসংহার – তাই, শিশুদের সততা শেখানো উচিত।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (e) they should be taught discipline too.
explanation_en: Adding another virtue to teach. 'Moreover' adds information.
explanation_bn: শেখানোর জন্য আরেকটি গুণ যোগ করা। 'Moreover' তথ্য যোগ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Climate change means the changes in climate. (a) climate on earth is constantly changing.
explanation_en: Introduces a contrasting or additional fact. 'However' shows contrast with the idea that climate change is a new phenomenon. Answer sheet gives 'However/At present/Today'.
explanation_bn: একটি বিপরীত বা অতিরিক্ত সত্য উল্লেখ করে। 'However' ধারণার সাথে বৈপরীত্য দেখায় যে জলবায়ু পরিবর্তন একটি নতুন ঘটনা। উত্তরপত্রে 'However/At present/Today'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (b) climate change, the weather pattern in any specific region on earth (c) across the whole earth is changing.
explanation_en: Prepositional phrase showing cause. 'Due to' or 'Because of' introduces the reason.
explanation_bn: কারণ দেখানো prepositional phrase। 'Due to' বা 'Because of' কারণ উল্লেখ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: ... the weather pattern in any specific region on earth (c) across the whole earth is changing.
explanation_en: Addition: specific region as well as the whole earth. 'As well as' or 'and' connects.
explanation_bn: সংযোজন: নির্দিষ্ট অঞ্চল এবং সমগ্র পৃথিবী। 'As well as' বা 'and' সংযুক্ত করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: We are cutting down trees for habitation and agricultural purpose. (d) use of chemicals in industries causes serious harm to the ozone layer.
explanation_en: Adding another human activity that harms. 'Besides' adds information.
explanation_bn: ক্ষতিকারক আরেকটি মানবিক কার্যকলাপ যোগ করা। 'Besides' তথ্য যোগ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (e) there is a rapid increase in temperature causing greenhouse effect.
explanation_en: Result of the previous activities. 'Consequently' shows the outcome.
explanation_bn: পূর্ববর্তী কার্যকলাপের ফলাফল। 'Consequently' পরিণতি দেখায়।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: People usually want to have their own way. They want to think and act (a) they like.
explanation_en: 'As they like' or 'what they like' – both possible. 'As' means 'in the way that', 'what' means 'the thing that'. Answer sheet gives 'as/what'.
explanation_bn: 'As they like' বা 'what they like' – উভয়ই সম্ভব। 'As' মানে 'যেভাবে', 'what' মানে 'যেটি'। উত্তরপত্রে 'as/what'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (b) one cannot have one's own way all the time.
explanation_en: Contrast: people want their own way, but cannot always have it. 'But' shows contrast.
explanation_bn: বৈপরীত্য: লোকেরা নিজের ইচ্ছামতো চায়, কিন্তু সব সময় পারে না। 'But' বৈপরীত্য দেখায়।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: A person cannot live in an environment without considering the interest of others (c) his own interest.
explanation_en: Addition: interest of others as well as his own. 'As well as' connects.
explanation_bn: সংযোজন: অন্যের স্বার্থ এবং নিজের স্বার্থ। 'As well as' সংযুক্ত করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: People in society may take their own decision. (d) these decisions ought not to be unjust (e) harmful to others.
explanation_en: Contrast: they may take decisions, but these must not be unjust. 'But' shows contrast.
explanation_bn: বৈপরীত্য: তারা সিদ্ধান্ত নিতে পারে, কিন্তু সেগুলো অন্যায় হতে পারে না। 'But' বৈপরীত্য দেখায়।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: ... these decisions ought not to be unjust (e) harmful to others.
explanation_en: Alternative: not unjust or harmful. 'Or' joins two negative conditions.
explanation_bn: বিকল্প: অন্যায় বা ক্ষতিকর নয়। 'Or' দুটি নেতিবাচক শর্ত যুক্ত করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (a) taking food, we should bear in mind (b) we do not eat just to satisfy hunger or to fill the belly.
explanation_en: 'While' introduces a time clause meaning 'during the time of taking food'.
explanation_bn: 'While' একটি সময় clause শুরু করে যার অর্থ 'খাবার গ্রহণের সময়'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: While taking food, we should bear in mind (b) we do not eat just to satisfy hunger or to fill the belly.
explanation_en: Noun clause as object of 'bear in mind' – 'that' introduces the clause.
explanation_bn: 'bear in mind' এর object হিসেবে noun clause – 'that' clause শুরু করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: We eat (c) we can preserve our health.
explanation_en: Purpose: we eat in order that we can preserve health. 'So that' expresses purpose.
explanation_bn: উদ্দেশ্য: আমরা খাই যাতে স্বাস্থ্য রক্ষা করতে পারি। 'So that' উদ্দেশ্য প্রকাশ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Some people living in the midst of plenty, do not eat the food they need for good health (d) they have no knowledge of the science of health and nutrition.
explanation_en: Reason: because they lack knowledge. 'Because' gives cause.
explanation_bn: কারণ: কারণ তাদের জ্ঞান নেই। 'Because' কারণ নির্দেশ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (e) they suffer from various diseases.
explanation_en: Result of not eating properly. 'Consequently' shows the outcome.
explanation_bn: সঠিক না খাওয়ার ফলাফল। 'Consequently' পরিণতি দেখায়।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: They give us not only food (a) oxygen.
explanation_en: Paired conjunction 'not only ... but also' – second part is 'but also'.
explanation_bn: যুগ্ম conjunction 'not only ... but also' – দ্বিতীয় অংশ 'but also'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: They protect us from natural calamities. (b) they are called the saviour of our environment.
explanation_en: Result: because they protect us, they are called saviour. 'Therefore' shows consequence.
explanation_bn: ফলাফল: কারণ তারা রক্ষা করে, তাই তারা ত্রাণকর্তা নামে পরিচিত। 'Therefore' পরিণতি দেখায়।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (c) many people are not aware of this.
explanation_en: Contrast: they are saviour, but people are unaware. 'But' shows contrast.
explanation_bn: বৈপরীত্য: তারা ত্রাণকর্তা, কিন্তু মানুষ সচেতন নয়। 'But' বৈপরীত্য দেখায়।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: They cut down trees randomly. (d) forestlands are shrinking.
explanation_en: Result of cutting trees. 'Consequently' shows outcome.
explanation_bn: গাছ কাটার ফলাফল। 'Consequently' পরিণতি দেখায়।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (e) people go on cutting down trees, one day there will be no trees left for us.
explanation_en: Condition: if people continue cutting, then no trees left. 'If' introduces condition.
explanation_bn: শর্ত: যদি মানুষ কাটতে থাকে, তাহলে গাছ থাকবে না। 'If' শর্ত নির্দেশ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Ripa is a student of class ten. (a) she is meritorious, she never takes pride in her merit.
explanation_en: Contrast: she is meritorious but not proud. 'Though' shows concession.
explanation_bn: বৈপরীত্য: সে মেধাবী কিন্তু গর্বিত নয়। 'Though' স্বীকৃতি বোঝায়।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (b) any weak student comes to her with any problem, she tries to help him.
explanation_en: Condition: if any weak student comes, she helps. 'If' introduces condition.
explanation_bn: শর্ত: যদি কোনো দুর্বল ছাত্র আসে, সে সাহায্য করে। 'If' শর্ত নির্দেশ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: She is respectful to the senior (c) affectionate to the junior.
explanation_en: Addition: respectful and affectionate. 'And' connects.
explanation_bn: সংযোজন: শ্রদ্ধাশীল এবং স্নেহশীল। 'And' সংযুক্ত করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: She is simple in behaviour (d) strict in principle.
explanation_en: Contrast: simple behaviour but strict principles. 'But' shows contrast.
explanation_bn: বৈপরীত্য: আচরণে সরল কিন্তু নীতিতে কঠোর। 'But' বৈপরীত্য দেখায়।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (e) everyone loves her.
explanation_en: Result of her qualities. 'So' shows consequence.
explanation_bn: তার গুণাবলির ফলাফল। 'So' পরিণতি দেখায়।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: 21 February is a red letter day in our national history. It is our pride (a) no nation of the world has ever fought for its language the way we fought.
explanation_en: Noun clause explaining what the pride is about – 'that' introduces the clause.
explanation_bn: গর্ব কী তা ব্যাখ্যা করা noun clause – 'that' clause শুরু করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: The proposal has been passed unanimously in the General Assembly of the UNESCO (b) some countries pointed out (c) the incident of 21st is related to the Bangalees only.
explanation_en: Relative adverb referring to a situation/context – 'where' means 'in which'.
explanation_bn: পরিস্থিতি/প্রসঙ্গ নির্দেশক relative adverb – 'where' মানে 'যেখানে'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: ... some countries pointed out (c) the incident of 21st is related to the Bangalees only.
explanation_en: Noun clause as object of 'pointed out' – 'that' introduces the clause.
explanation_bn: 'pointed out' এর object হিসেবে noun clause – 'that' clause শুরু করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (d) the recognition of the day, (e) the International Mother Language Day by UNESCO has upheld the prestige of Bangalees all over the world.
explanation_en: Transition showing contrast or conclusion. 'However' shows contrast with the previous objection; 'Thus' shows result. Answer sheet gives 'However/Thus'.
explanation_bn: বৈপরীত্য বা উপসংহার দেখানো ট্রানজিশন। 'However' পূর্ববর্তী আপত্তির সাথে বৈপরীত্য দেখায়; 'Thus' ফলাফল দেখায়। উত্তরপত্রে 'However/Thus'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: ... the recognition of the day, (e) the International Mother Language Day by UNESCO has upheld the prestige of Bangalees all over the world.
explanation_en: Preposition 'as' meaning 'in the role of' – recognized as International Mother Language Day.
explanation_bn: Preposition 'as' অর্থ 'রূপে' – আন্তর্জাতিক মাতৃভাষা দিবস হিসেবে স্বীকৃত।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Global warming is increasing day by day (a) deforestation.
explanation_en: Cause: due to deforestation. Prepositional phrase needed before noun.
explanation_bn: কারণ: বন উজাড়ের কারণে। noun এর আগে prepositional phrase প্রয়োজন।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: We cut down trees (b) never think of planting more trees.
explanation_en: Contrast: we cut down but never think of planting. 'But' shows opposition.
explanation_bn: বৈপরীত্য: আমরা কাটি কিন্তু বেশি লাগানোর কথা ভাবি না। 'But' বিরোধিতা বোঝায়।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (c) humans and other living beings are in the threat of extinction.
explanation_en: Result of deforestation. 'So' shows consequence.
explanation_bn: বন উজাড়ের ফলাফল। 'So' পরিণতি দেখায়।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Time is coming (d) there will be no tree left for us.
explanation_en: Relative adverb for time – 'when' modifies 'time'.
explanation_bn: সময়ের জন্য relative adverb – 'when' 'time' কে modify করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (e) we have to face bitter consequence of deforestation.
explanation_en: Final result. 'Consequently' shows outcome.
explanation_bn: চূড়ান্ত ফলাফল। 'Consequently' পরিণতি দেখায়।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Rural life and urban life have many common sides. (a) differences between them are greater.
explanation_en: Contrast: common sides but greater differences. 'But' shows contrast.
explanation_bn: বৈপরীত্য: সাধারণ দিক আছে কিন্তু পার্থক্য বেশি। 'But' বৈপরীত্য দেখায়।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Rural people do not have adequate educational and medical facilities. (b) they face problems with their communication network.
explanation_en: Adding another problem. 'Besides' adds information.
explanation_bn: আরেকটি সমস্যা যোগ করা। 'Besides' তথ্য যোগ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (c) the urban people enjoy adequate educational and medical facilities.
explanation_en: Contrast with rural people. 'On the other hand' introduces a contrasting point.
explanation_bn: গ্রামীণ মানুষের সাথে বৈপরীত্য। 'On the other hand' একটি বিপরীত বিষয় উল্লেখ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (d) the people of cities and towns enjoy a smooth and easy communication system.
explanation_en: Adding another advantage of urban life. 'Again' or 'Moreover' adds information.
explanation_bn: নগর জীবনের আরেকটি সুবিধা যোগ করা। 'Again' বা 'Moreover' তথ্য যোগ করে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: (e) there is a rush of people to come to cities from villages every year.
explanation_en: Conclusion from the advantages of cities. 'That is why' or 'So' shows result.
explanation_bn: শহরগুলোর সুবিধার উপসংহার। 'That is why' বা 'So' ফলাফল দেখায়।
